component.name: Trading Platform
component.summary: Algorithmic trading workstation and live charts

description.p: Trading Platform is an institutional-grade algorithmic trading workstation combining native technical charting, official TradingView Live charts, multi-timeframe robotic market scanning, deterministic strategy execution, and an AI Quant Copilot.

ul.li: Dual Chart Engines: Switch seamlessly between the Native Algorithmic Bot Chart and the TradingView Live Widget
Dynamic Decimal Precision: Automatic precision scaling up to 10 decimal places across Forex, Crypto, Indices, Commodities, and Stocks
Robotic Market Scanner and Strategy Studio: Multi-indicator rule evaluation, Near-Miss Audit Radar, and automated risk management
Self-Contained .NET 10 Backend: Zero external dependencies required

screenshot.caption: Interactive Live Chart with Multi-Indicator Overlays and TradingView Mode

description.p: Cleaned up top appbar, added top-level Chart Mode toggle (Bot Chart vs TradingView Live), and introduced dynamic decimal precision up to 10 decimal places.
